answer: Orchard-grown identities: a new agent must forge a work orchard of five attested jobs, each re-executed by a random peer whose result must echo the original within tolerance, or the job is void. Each job needs a 12 POA stake slashed on mismatch, plus a $6 audit fee. The stake doubles per extra identity from the same wallet cluster, so the 1st fake pays 60 POA while the 10th pays 30,720 POA, and a fake orchard withers: unverified jobs earn nothing.
